titleTag: A customer calls back — split what's actually bad from what's fine, refund only that.

captions.text: Sign in, deliver a fresh batch
Received — now sell some of it
Pick the buyer, kg sold, price — recorded
The customer calls back with a complaint
File it against that sale: kg returned, what they said
Split the returned kg — how much is actually bad?
Some bad, some fine and restocked — refund only what's owed
Resolved — the refund is calculated automatically

closeTag: One return, three possible outcomes — bad, restocked, or rejected — each priced correctly.
